source.article: L05 Division Algebras, Triality, and Exceptional Magic, published version of record 2026-08-29
locations: §4 opening six-form decomposition Eq under title
§4.1 su(3) 3x3 matrix Eq.(10), commutator output five component equations immediately below, explicit basis brackets and Cartan-root brackets
§4.2 sp(3) quaternionic 3x3 matrix Eq.(12), commutator output six component equations, exact Clifford basis brackets Eq.(13)
§4.2 generalized reflection and canonical triality conjugation Eq.(14)
§4.3 f4 and split analogues: source-specific forms (still require full separate census)

legacy_ssc.body: The triality Lie algebras are constructed by adjoining three D-role carriers to tri(D), yielding su(3), sp(3), f4(-52) and split/noncompact analogues with explicit representation decompositions and Lie brackets.

defects.evidence: L133 G1 R07 refers to an explicit eight-dimensional bracket system, but its formula_ast contains only SOURCE_FAMILY_BRACKET_SYSTEM(C-family,eq4.2). It does not preserve source five independent commutator component equations or source 3x3 traceless anti-Hermitian matrix equality with its multiple source presentations, signs, conjugations, roles and factors.
source_semantics_missing: 3x3 matrix entries and real/complex role binding; traceless source 2-parameter gauge
five commutator outputs B1_3, B2_3, v_3, psi_3, chi_3 with exact source order and signs
explicit nonzero basis-level root/Cartan brackets and antisymmetrized partners

defects.evidence: L133 G1 R08 says 'explicit twenty-one-dimensional bracket systems' but does not conserve the quaternionic 3x3 source matrix nor six ordered bracket expressions for (M3,P3,V3,v3,psi3,chi3). The source separately prints 12-by-12 real and 6-by-6 complex presentation information; none follows from name sp(3).
source_semantics_missing: six commutator component equations preserving noncommutative order and inner conjugation
two distinct source matrix realization scopes and dimension claims

defects.evidence: G3 0.1 R04 and R05 are marked CORE_CLOSED because source-specific maps are said to be explicit/already represented. Actual L133 G1 0.1/G2 0.1 contain only high-level family descriptors and no exact tensor-index or ordered product formula trees; this does not establish an exact reconstructable map. The old parent closure pins L127 G7 0.1 and L132 G7 0.1, both stale.

defects.evidence: Source §4.1/§4.2 states presentation-specific matrix systems, coefficients and an explicitly phase-incomplete root-space view. The old G1 does not expose these as separately reversible source relations, potentially collapsing source-representation non-equivalence.
